# Dependent interface carrier and callback

Independently authored Java8 declarations retain T extends Iterable<E>, a separate
Object-bounded E and an invariant callback<E>, returning the original scoped T.
The frozen observer checks exact inputs, callback identity, iterator actions,
partial failures, opaque results, ignored calls and delayed Collection casts.
Every source and SDK output unit compiles, with original metadata, roles,
Exceptions and helpers compared. Private application bytes and behavior are
excluded from these fixtures.
